_doc: Per-zone ambience density overrides. Loaded by AmbienceDensityAutoload.gd at game start. Gameplay code calls AmbienceDensity.set_active_zone(zone_id) when the player enters a triggered area; the autoload pushes the matching density multiplier (and optional biome_hint to crossfade) into the BiomeAmbienceController. Density 1.0 = recipe default; <1 = sparser sweeteners; >1 = denser.

library_courtyard._notes: Quiet civic space; reduce wildlife rate.

battle_arena._notes: Combat zone; more frequent distant events for tension.

deep_cave._notes: Player should feel isolated; very sparse.

town_market._notes: Bustling; more wildlife (birds, distant chatter via foley).

boss_arena._notes: All ambience suppressed; combat music carries the moment.

haunted_grove._notes: Slightly denser; the unease comes from sweeteners not music.

lava_fissure_descent._notes: Increasing density as the player descends — set per checkpoint.

underwater_temple._notes: Sparse to feel oppressive; whales every 2-3 minutes.

burned_village._notes: Almost silent, occasional ember and wood crack.
